author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Don't feed screenshots to Opus and call the compute use tool directly.  You are flushing tokens down the toilet 

Instead ask Opus to create a bespoke OpenCV program to understand the UI that it needs to control, then operate the computer use from the json boundary box and OCR text instead.

Not only a lot cheaper, it runs a lot faster too .
